title: unreplied_ticket_count and unreplied_unsolved_ticket_count are always 0 in zendesk__ticket_summary
fix: zendesk__ticket_summary counts tickets where total_agent_replies < 0, but zendesk__ticket_metrics sets total_agent_replies to coalesce(count_agent_replies, 0), so it is never negative and both counts are always 0. Count tickets where total_agent_replies = 0 instead, and add an integrity test (enabled with fivetran_validation_tests_enabled) that checks both counts against zendesk__ticket_metrics.

steps.name: bug reproduced: main's model fails the new integrity test
steps.run: git apply {patch} && git checkout HEAD -- models/zendesk__ticket_summary.sql && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt seed && dbt run --select +zendesk__ticket_summary && dbt test --select ticket_summary_unreplied_count_match --vars '{fivetran_validation_tests_enabled: true}'

steps.name: fixed: with the fix, the same build and test pass
steps.run: git apply {patch} && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt seed && dbt run --select +zendesk__ticket_summary && dbt test --select ticket_summary_unreplied_count_match --vars '{fivetran_validation_tests_enabled: true}'

steps.name: nothing else changes: fixwitness, told that only the two counts should change
steps.run: git apply {patch} && python -m fixwitness check --base HEAD --no-attacks --expect-change zendesk__ticket_summary.unreplied_ticket_count,zendesk__ticket_summary.unreplied_unsolved_ticket_count --out-dir {out}/fw_fix
